table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	EmpCode=A.EmpCode, 
	EmployeeName=E.FullName,
	Category = C.Name,
	Department = D.Name,
	Designation = DS.Name,
	TimeIn = A.TimeIn,
	TimeOut= A.TimeOut,
	HoursWorked = CAST(DATEDIFF(n, A.TimeIn, ISNULL(A.TimeOut, GETDATE())) / 60 AS INT),
	MinWorked = CAST(DATEDIFF(n, A.TimeIn, ISNULL(A.TimeOut, GETDATE())) % 60 AS INT),
	Status = (SELECT S.Name FROM EMP_AttendanceStatus S WHERE A.AttendanceStatusCode = S.AttendanceStatusCode),
	Comments=A.Comments
FROM 
	EMP_Attendance A,
	EMP_Employee E, 
	EMP_Department D, 
	EMP_Category C, 
	EMP_Designation DS
WHERE 
	A.TimeIN BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	C.EmpCatCode IN (:ai_empcatcode) AND
	D.DeptCode IN (:ai_deptcode) AND
	A.EmpCode = E.EmpCode AND
	E.DeptCode = D.DeptCode AND 
	E.EmpCatCode = C.EmpCatCode AND 
	E.DesigCode = DS.DesigCode AND
	E.Active = 'Y'
ORDER BY
	Department,
	EmployeeName,
	TimeIn
table.sort: department A, employeename A, timein A
